set_value.comment: Strength of all ships which have been requested for this subgoal, including ones finished building

debug_text.text: 'Wants strength: ' + $DesiredShipStrength + ' - Current strength: ' + this.$CurrentStrength + ' - Requested strength: ' + this.$RequestedShipStrength

'Requested ship is no longer valid. ID: ' + $RequestedShips.{$i} + ' - It should have been removed from this list by other means. [Owen]'

$DebugText + ' re-purposed standby ship ' + this.$StandbyShip.knownname + ' ' + this.$StandbyShip + ' with strength ' + $EFS_Result + ' force strength is now: ' + $ForceStrength + ' - desired: '+ $DesiredShipStrength
$DebugText + ' commandeered ' + $Ship.knownname + ' ' + $Ship + ' with strength ' + $EFS_Result + ' force strength is now: ' + $ForceStrength + ' - desired: '+ $DesiredShipStrength
$DebugText + $Ships.count + ' ships with force strength of ' + $ForceStrength + ' out of wanted strength ' + $DesiredShipStrength

do_if.value: ((not $NextJobRequestCheck? or player.age gt $NextJobRequestCheck) and [$DesiredShipStrength - $ForceStrength, $RequestStrengthAllowance - $RequestedShipsStrength].min gt 0) and not @md.TM_Empire_Purchase.Request.$Pending and player.age ge @md.TM_Empire_Purchase.Request.$NextAttempt and (@md.TM_Empire_Purchase.Request.$LastResult.$state != 'delivered' or @md.TM_Empire_Purchase.Request.$LastResult.$accepted)

debug_text.text: $DebugText + 'Requested job ship to be created. Job ' + $SelectedJob + '; Job zone: ' + $JobMainZone + ' ' + $JobMainZone.knownname
